visualCharacteristics: Single outlined email field with inline arrow submit button, centered, max ~400px.
usage: Renders a static email signup form locally; it does not load /widgets/ assets and does not call any Shopify or newsletter endpoint. Optional configuration as key/value rows (placeholder, submit, success, action) or as query params on a /widgets/newsletter/newsletter.html link. Without 'action' the form validates the email and shows the success message without leaving the page. Place it in a section with style 'centered' below an H2 and intro paragraph.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single-field email signup. Add an 'action' row once a real newsletter provider endpoint exists.
